reference.question: Given \(|a|=5\), \(|b|=2\), and \(a<b\), what are all possible values of \(a-b\)? (Separate the values with commas; any order is acceptable.)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Restrict the signed possibilities

\(a=\pm5\) and \(b=\pm2\). Since \(a<b\), \(a\) can only be \(-5\). When \(b=2\), \(a-b=-7\); when \(b=-2\), \(a-b=-3\).
